ROLE

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will be at the heart of our mission to integrate AI into the processes and workflows serving DailyPay. Situated directly within DailyPay's Engineering organization, you will empower other departments to create AI-based solutions and act as their premier "go-to" technical leader. 

In this cross-functional role, you work with domain experts to capture workflows as skills, uncover workflow bottlenecks, and build the custom software, scripts, and model integrations needed to bring DailyPay’s AI strategy to life. By bridging the gap between enterprise-grade AI engineering and daily business unit execution, you will raise the bar for engineering excellence and ensure our technology directly translates into enhanced financial wellness for our users.




HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Discover and Build: Embedded across departments to shadow domain experts to uncover workflows and pain points, design and ship automation (MVPs, custom scripts, API integrations), and mature solutions into managed, durable agents.

 - Own Outcomes: Define metrics with stakeholders, track adoption and ROI, and prioritize projects based on feasibility, risk, and business value.

 - Build Reliable AI Systems: Design, build, evaluate, and operate AI workflows; implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and feedback loops.

 - Be the resident expert: Serve as the on-the-ground authority for AI questions. Help non-technical teams evaluate, configure, and get more out of the AI features already sitting in their existing SaaS stack.

 - Elevate AI literacy: Mentor peers in AI development, build learnings into reusable documentation and training, and demo emerging AI capabilities to inspire many across the company.

 - Enrich Engineering: Steer hosted harness and local harness development with the distilled problems, prototypes, and established workflows created with various departments.

 - Optimize AI Performance and Cost: Benchmark model performance, optimize prompt/token usage, manage API latency, and monitor operational costs to keep AI applications efficient and scalable as usage grows.

 - Promote safe and responsible usage: Ensure department-level AI work adheres to company policy on data privacy, security, and ethical use.




WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Software Engineering Foundation: 3+ years of professional software development experience, featuring strong proficiency in Go or JavaScript (ideally both) and standard engineering practices (version control, testing).

 - Practical AI/LLM Implementation: Hands-on experience building, or contributing to applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) or managing complex workflows using AI tools. Has a deep understanding of managing larger AI-powered projects including agent design, skills, context, and memory.

 - Platform Communications: Experienced in working with APIs and MCPs of typical company platforms like Jira, Github, or Salesforce

 - Consultative Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate complex machine learning and engineering concepts into plain, business-friendly language for non-technical stakeholders.

 - Business Acumen & Problem Solving: Proven track record of analyzing business operations, formulating technical requirements from vague problems, and prioritizing solutions based on ROI.

 - Cross-Functional Adaptability & EQ: High emotional intelligence with a demonstrated comfort working autonomously inside non-technical departments, building trust as a collaborative peer rather than a rigid IT gatekeeper.
